::: {#exm-reflexive-or-not}
#### Reflexive or not

- The relation $T$ of @exm-shares-letter is reflexive (@def-reflexive),
  since every word of $V$ has a letter in common with itself.
- The relation $B$ of @exm-beats is not reflexive, since rock does not beat rock.
- The relation $P$ of @exm-parent is not reflexive, since Ada is not her own parent.

:::
